voiceDirection: One consistent FEMALE CHILD voice throughout, a little girl speaking as a sweet cartoon bunny. Clearly feminine and young: a light, small, high, delicate girlish timbre and soft smooth rounded tone. Natural youthful resonance, tender and sweet. No low or husky adult register. Clear gentle English pronunciation, conversational warmth, fluid phrasing, natural pitch variation and small pauses. Soft spoken rather than whispered. The invitation and choice questions sound shy, curious and hopeful. Oh lovely and the happy dance sound softly delighted with playful joy. The final reassurance sounds kind and comforting. Keep emotions subtle and natural while keeping the same little girl voice. Clean dry speech only, no music, no sound effects, no laughter or background noise. Speak only the supplied words.
notes: Active narration directly in the existing app. No comparison interface. Video frames and accepted target speech windows are preserved; original effects are completely replaced.
